evidence: Fixed-format source with comment lines in column 7 (*)
ORGANIZATION INDEXED / ACCESS MODE DYNAMIC file control
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS

purpose.summary: This is a batch report/list program (component of the ORCA Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) that produces an inpatient/outpatient patient list ('在院患者一覧' – patient census list). It reads patient, insurance, medical-act, and hospitalization history data from indexed files and writes a formatted print output, including error file handling.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical receipt software)

notable_features: Part of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software project
Heavy use of COPY statements for modular record layouts (30+ copybooks)
ORGANIZATION INDEXED with DYNAMIC access for temporary work file
Japanese-language comments encoded in latin-1 (actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as latin-1)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – DB access via CALL subprograms (MCP pattern)
80 CALL statements indicating extensive subprogram-based architecture
Version history spanning 2004–2008 with named maintainers
OCCURS tables for insurance combination and self-pay management
Error file (RECEERR-FILE) for runtime error reporting
verdict.notes: The file was decoded as latin-1 but the Japanese comments are almost certainly EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The source is clearly genuine production COBOL from the ORCA medical software project. The truncation at 16000 chars covers only the DATA DIVISION; the PROCEDURE DIVISION is not shown but its presence is confirmed by mechanical indicators (perform_count=85, call_count=80, goto_count=0).
